events.title: Christmas Lights Spectacular
events.description: Festive light installations and amusement rides at the Gardens.
events.note: Open 5:30–10:30pm, rides 6–10pm, closed 25 Dec. Longer drive than an hour from many Central Coast suburbs.

events.title: Road to Bethlehem
events.description: Walk-through live Christmas story with scenes, performers and festive atmosphere.
events.note: Official ticket release expected from 1 December 2026.

events.title: The Greatest Christmas Show
events.description: Stage show with Christmas music, magic and high-energy performance.
events.note: Officially one show at 7:30pm on 14 December; 1h50 incl interval. Strobe and haze effects.

events.title: Carols in the Stadium
events.description: Big Central Coast Christmas carols concert with a festive family atmosphere.

events.title: Carols in the Park
events.description: Christmas Eve carols by the waterfront; scheduled 6–9pm.

events.title: New Year’s Eve at Gosford
events.description: Family-friendly waterfront celebrations and early fireworks are reported for 2026.
events.note: Central Coast Council official page still displayed 2025 when checked.

events.title: New Year’s Eve at The Entrance
events.description: Reported 2026 family celebration with a planned 9pm fireworks finale.
events.note: Central Coast Council official page still displayed 2025 when checked.

events.title: Avoca Beachside Markets
events.description: Waterfront makers market featuring stalls, food and local entertainment.
events.note: Usual fourth Sunday of the month; check for holiday changes or cancellations.

events.title: Central Coast Aqua Park
events.description: Inflatable obstacle course and water challenges for active family fun.
events.note: Official site lists season reopening 7 Nov 2026. Check operating days, age and adult supervision rules.

events.title: Treetops Adventure Central Coast
events.description: Forest rope courses and ziplines with different levels for children and teens.
events.note: General year-round activity; holiday operating days and course suitability vary.

events.title: Australian Reptile Park
events.description: Reptiles, native wildlife encounters and keeper demonstrations.
events.note: Regular attraction; check show schedule and public-holiday hours.

events.title: Glenworth Valley Adventures
events.description: Horse riding and other outdoor adventures in the hinterland.
events.note: Horse riding minimum age 7; some other adventures have higher age limits.

events.title: Minecraft Experience: Villager Rescue
events.description: In-person interactive Minecraft quest at the Big Top, Luna Park.
events.cost: From A$49; family multipack 4–9 from A$41.65 per ticket
events.note: 18 Dec 2026–26 Apr 2027. Closed Tuesdays as regular schedule; check holiday exceptions.

events.title: Prehistoric Planet: Discovering Dinosaurs
events.description: Large-scale immersive experience that brings prehistoric environments and dinosaurs to life.
events.note: 50-minute loop; 11–18 Dec weekdays 10am–1pm, weekends 9am–1pm; 19 Dec onwards daily 9am–1pm, closed 25 Dec. Under-12s need adult.

events.title: The Christmas Spectacular
events.description: Christmas stage extravaganza combining circus performance, magic, dance and music.

events.title: The Nutcracker
events.description: The Australian Ballet’s festive production with elaborate costumes and music.

events.title: Jolly Christmas Night Markets
events.description: Festive evening markets with food, performances and Christmas atmosphere.
events.note: Full season 10–20 Dec 2026, from 4pm to 10:30pm.

events.title: Christmas at the Cathedral
events.description: Christmas light projections, food stalls, gifts and roving performers.

events.title: Storytime Ballet: Cinderella
events.description: A narrated, interactive ballet experience for children.
events.cost: A$59–98 depending on section/session; A$8.95 booking fee per transaction
events.note: 55 minutes, suitable for all ages; aimed primarily at younger children.

events.title: Christmas Carol Goes Wrong
events.description: Slapstick stage comedy about a disastrous Christmas production.
events.note: Official recommended age is 10+; not recommended for the 9-year-old.

events.title: Carols in the Domain
events.description: Major televised Christmas carols celebration with live performances.

events.title: Darling Harbour New Year’s Eve
events.description: Family-friendly New Year’s Eve with free fireworks at 9pm and midnight.
events.note: Official 2026 listing confirms 9pm and midnight fireworks; free, first-come first-served, capacity restrictions and no guaranteed re-entry.

events.title: Moonlight Cinema Sydney
events.description: Outdoor movie nights featuring Christmas favourites and other films.
events.note: Official 2026 schedule: Home Alone 12 Dec, Polar Express 15 Dec, Elf 19 Dec, Home Alone 2 on 20 Dec, Arthur Christmas 21 Dec, The Cat in the Hat preview 30 Dec. January programme pending.

events.title: The Rocks Markets: Christmas Edition
events.description: Festive weekend market stalls, local makers and seasonal treats.
events.note: Friday–Sunday trading; verify individual dates and hours.

events.title: Wundrful World of Christmas
events.description: Immersive family Christmas adventure with a simulated North Pole journey and elves’ workshop.

events.title: A Christmas Celebration
events.description: Sydney Musical and Opera Society’s Christmas-themed performance at The Art House.
events.note: Check programme and whether it appeals to both age groups.

events.title: Darling Harbour Christmas Festival
events.description: Free family Christmas festival with kids’ performances, games, crafts, Santa, choir and dance party. 4:30–9pm.
events.note: Official programme lists 4:30pm opening, Santa arrival 8:15pm, fireworks at Cockle Bay at 9pm. Some stage acts target younger children, but crafts, games, choir and fireworks suit a wider family audience.

events.title: Terrigal Christmas Carols
events.description: Community Christmas carols from 7pm, with free activities and refreshments.
events.note: Local event roundup, recheck organiser before travelling.

events.title: Pearl Beach Twilight Carols
events.description: Outdoor carols 4:30–7pm, Santa, stalls and face painting.
events.cost: Free; gold coin for face painting
events.note: Local event roundup, recheck organiser before travelling.

events.title: Sydney Opera House Guided Tour
events.description: Guided behind-the-scenes tour, subject to session availability.
events.cost: Prebook adult A$50, child A$30, family A$130
events.note: No tours 25 or 31 December; confirm selected date and time.

events.title: Darling Harbour Saturday Fireworks (12 Dec)
events.description: Free 9pm Saturday fireworks at Cockle Bay.

events.title: Darling Harbour Saturday Fireworks (19 Dec)
events.description: Free 9pm Saturday fireworks at Cockle Bay.

events.title: Cockle Bay Christmas Spectacular
events.description: Free waterfront Christmas spectacular with flyboarders, wakeboarders, a water-ski human pyramid and Santa's surprise arrival. Finish with 9pm fireworks.
events.note: Exact show start time not verified; fireworks scheduled for 9pm, weather permitting.

events.title: Darling Harbour Floating Christmas Tree
events.description: See the 15-metre floating Christmas tree sparkling on Cockle Bay, especially after dark; a free festive photo stop.
events.note: Official installation runs 20 November–26 December 2026; dates shown are the overlap with the family holiday period.

events.title: Central Coast Farmers Market
events.description: Local produce and food market at Gosford Showground; suitable for a relaxed family morning.
events.source: Love Central Coast official events directory
events.note: Official directory shows market dates continuing through 20 December 2026; confirm the specific 20 December session and hours with organiser.

change_log.details: Cockle Bay Christmas Spectacular (12 Dec), Darling Harbour Floating Christmas Tree (through 26 Dec), and Central Coast Farmers Market (20 Dec; exact session still needs organiser confirmation). Official sources: https://www.darlingharbour.com/whats-on/campaigns/christmas ; https://www.darlingharbour.com/whats-on/events/floating-christmas-tree ; https://www.lovecentralcoast.com/events-listing/markets

Darling Harbour Christmas Festival stage programme and 9pm fireworks confirmed at https://www.darlingharbour.com/whats-on/events/christmas-festival. Gosford and The Entrance 2026 NYE dates remain unconfirmed; Love Central Coast Christmas page still refers to 2025.
Darling Harbour Christmas Festival (19 Dec), Terrigal carols (12 Dec), Pearl Beach carols (23 Dec), Opera House guided tours, and Darling Harbour Saturday fireworks (12 and 19 Dec).
Wyong Greatest Christmas Show has one officially listed performance at 7:30pm (not 3:30pm); official ticket tiers recorded.
Minecraft pricing, Carriageworks dinosaur hours, Hunter Valley lights opening hours, Cinderella ticket bands, Moonlight Cinema December films, and Darling Harbour 2026 New Year fireworks.
Central Coast Gosford and The Entrance 2026 NYE celebrations remain unconfirmed by the official Love Central Coast page, which still describes welcoming 2026. Do not treat those as confirmed.
